sections.heading: Two Certificates, Real Experience
sections.body: PTI graduates leave with a DIT certificate, a UBTEB certificate, and an industrial attachment testimonial — proof of both trade-test competence and real workplace exposure.

sections.heading: Self-Employment
sections.body: PTI's motto is Self Reliance. Many graduates go on to run their own workshop, salon, garage, catering business, farm enterprise, or shop, applying the entrepreneurship component woven into training.

sections.heading: Formal Employment
sections.body: Graduates are also prepared for formal employment — in construction firms, garages, hotels, offices, IT support roles, and agribusinesses — using the same production-unit and industrial-attachment experience that employers look for.
